nodes.name: ABEngine.ts
nodes.summary: A/B testing engine for template variants: manages variant state, persistence, and active-variant selection for the template mini-UI.

nodes.name: ABEngine
nodes.summary: Manages A/B test variants for a template with create/delete/setActive operations and local persistence via storage keys.

nodes.name: ABPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Right-rail panel UI exposing the ABEngine: lists variants, lets the operator create/select/delete variants, and triggers preview rendering.

nodes.name: ABPanel
nodes.summary: React component rendering the A/B variant management UI wired to ABEngine and URL state.

nodes.name: ABTestPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Full A/B test management panel: creates and tracks experiments with telemetry events, badges, and variant comparison for a template/platform/user.

nodes.summary: Renders the A/B test UI with experiment creation, variant selection, and metric display, emitting `recordAbEvent` calls for telemetry.

nodes.name: recordAbEvent
nodes.summary: Helper that funnels A/B test lifecycle events through the template telemetry bus.

nodes.name: DashboardPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Right-rail dashboard panel summarizing template status, recent actions, and quick links into other mini-UI panels.

nodes.name: DashboardPanel
nodes.summary: React component rendering the template dashboard summary view in the right rail.

nodes.summary: Displays the cohort calibration (ECE) badge with status and tooltip explaining model reliability.

nodes.name: PredictionResults
nodes.summary: Renders the VPS prediction result block (score, tier, confidence) inside the validation panel.

nodes.name: InceptionPanel.tsx

nodes.name: InceptionPanel
nodes.summary: React component for the template inception phase, capturing intent and platform for downstream optimization.

nodes.name: OptimizePanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Optimization panel that surfaces fix suggestions, hashtag tuning, and editing-coach feedback (Pack 2) for the current template.

nodes.name: OptimizePanel
nodes.summary: React component for template optimization: integrates fix runners, signal bridge events, and Pack 2 editing-coach results.

nodes.name: ScriptsPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Panel that manages saved script variants for a template, exposing run/clone/delete actions and emitting telemetry events.

nodes.name: ScriptsPanel
nodes.summary: React component listing the template's saved scripts with run/clone/delete affordances.

nodes.name: ValidatePanel.tsx

nodes.name: ValidatePanel
nodes.summary: React component that runs slot validation and presents issues, with sound and toast feedback.

nodes.name: PreviewKernel.ts
nodes.summary: Headless preview rendering kernel that debounces updates, manages cancellation, and emits progress/result/error callbacks for the template preview.

nodes.summary: Debounced/cancelable preview engine driving template render lifecycle with onProgress/onResult/onError hooks.

nodes.name: usePreviewKernel
nodes.summary: Hook returning preview state and an update function backed by a PreviewKernel instance.

nodes.summary: Realtime signal bridge built on EventTarget for cross-component pub/sub of template lifecycle events.

nodes.summary: Public pub/sub facade for template realtime signals, delegating to an EventTargetAdapter.

nodes.name: EventTargetAdapter
nodes.summary: Adapter that wraps a browser EventTarget channel to provide connect/disconnect/broadcast/subscribe primitives.

nodes.summary: Parses the URL hash into a typed mini-UI state object with safe fallbacks for malformed input.

nodes.name: toCanvasHash
nodes.summary: Encodes mini-UI state into the canonical canvas hash form for deep-linking.

nodes.name: ValidationEngine.ts
nodes.summary: Slot-level validation engine that checks template slots for unresolved braces and other structural issues before publish.

nodes.name: ValidationEngine
nodes.summary: Runs configured rules over template slots and returns a list of validation issues with severity.

nodes.name: Breadcrumb.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-bar breadcrumb component for the template mini-UI showing the active template name and back navigation.

nodes.name: events.ts
nodes.summary: Telemetry helpers for the template mini-UI: logTemplateEvent for user actions and logTokenUsage for LLM cost tracking.

nodes.name: logTemplateEvent
nodes.summary: Posts a template lifecycle event to the telemetry endpoint with template/platform/user context.

nodes.name: logTokenUsage
nodes.summary: Records LLM token usage (provider, model, tokens, cost) for the template mini-UI session.

nodes.name: seedFirst3sCue
nodes.summary: Generates a hook/first-3s cue suggestion for the template based on platform conventions.

nodes.name: optimizeHashtags
nodes.summary: Improves a hashtag list given platform rules and template context (dedupe, format, trim).

nodes.summary: Dispatch helper that applies a named fix to the current template state and emits a telemetry event.

nodes.name: runOptimizationPipeline
nodes.summary: Runs the full sequence of automatic fixes over template slots for a given platform, returning the optimized slots.

nodes.name: parseParityCombos
